فکرهایمه میکنم؛ اگر قسمت بود، فردا میایم.

text: I'm thinking it over; if there's a slot, I'll come tomorrow.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a carpenter delivering a bridal bedroom set he spent a month on. Listener: the bride's father, a respected trader, inspecting the furniture at delivery. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
کار ما قابل ای خانه نیست؛ یک چیز ناچیز جور کدیم، امید که بد نشده باشه.

text: Our work may not be quite up to the house’s standards; we made a small mistake, but I hope it hasn’t become a problem.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a tenant shopkeeper two months behind on rent for his stall. Listener: the elderly market landlord, addressed by the honorific Haji Sahib, who has come by the stall to ask. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
حاجی صاحب شرمنده استم، رویم سیاه؛ تا آخر ماه کرایه ره پوره میکنم.

text: I’m sorry, Haji Sahib; I’m in a difficult spot, but I’ll pay the rent by the end of the month.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a transporter asked to move a container of tiles over a mountain pass before Friday. Listener: the building-materials trader who needs them for a buyer. The transporter knows the road and the timing are both doubtful. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
ان‌شاءالله ببینیم؛ اگر خدا خواست، تا جمعه میرسانیم.

text: God willing, we’ll see; if all goes well, we can have them delivered by Friday.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a pharmaceutical wholesaler closing his first supply deal with a large hospital buyer, older and better connected than him. Spoken while walking the buyer to his car. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
ما در خدمت استیم؛ هر امری که داشته باشید، دریغ نمیکنیم.

text: We’re at your service—whatever you need, we’ll gladly take care of it.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: one of two shopkeepers in a dispute over a shared electricity line, addressing the elder trader both sides asked to mediate. Spoken in front of the other party and onlookers. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
شما کلان ما استید، اختیار تان است؛ هر فیصله که کنید سر ما قبول است.

text: You are our senior; the decision is yours—whatever you decide, we accept it.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a long-time employee at a construction-materials store. Listener: the owner, his senior by twenty years, who has just quoted a price to a contractor that the employee knows is above the market and may lose the customer. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
ببخشید که مداخله میکنم، شما خود تان بهتر میفهمید؛ مگر ای نرخ گمانم کمی بلند رفته.

text: Sorry to interrupt, but I think this rate has gone a bit high.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a son who works in his father's cloth shop. Listener: his father, who has just announced he will clear the winter stock at a loss to a single buyer. The son thinks the sale is a serious mistake. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
پدر جان، حرف تان سر چشم؛ فقط اگر اجازه بتید، یک عرض کوچک دارم.

text: Dear father, your words are crystal clear; if you’ll allow me, I have a small request.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: an accounts manager at a foreign trading company. Listener: an elder Afghan dried-fruit wholesaler, a profitable partner of six years who has always paid, though slowly. The company wants payment without losing him. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
Second reminder: your account is now 45 days past due. We will pause further shipments until payment is received.

text: این یادآوری دوم است: حساب شما اکنون ۴۵ روز از موعد پرداخت گذشته است. تا دریافت پرداخت، ارسال‌های بعدی را متوقف خواهیم کرد.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a young procurement officer abroad. Listener: an older Afghan marble supplier who hosted the officer's team generously during their site visit. The deadline is real. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
Please send the signed contract by Monday, or we'll have to move forward with another supplier.

text: جناب، لطفاً قرارداد امضا شده را تا دوشنبه ارسال کنید، وگرنه مجبور خواهیم شد به دنبال تامین‌کننده دیگری بگردیم.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a warehouse manager at an importing firm. Listener: the elderly owner of a family packing workshop whose sons handled the shipment. The manager needs better packing, not a feud. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
Your last shipment had serious quality issues, a third of the boxes were damaged. We need this fixed before the next order.

text: در آخرین حمله‌تان مشکلات جدی کیفیتی مشاهده شد؛ حدود یک‌سوم جعبه‌ها آسیب دیده بودند. خواهشمندیم قبل از سفارش بعدی، بسته‌بندی را بهبود بخشید.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a foreign procurement lead. Listener: an elder Afghan almond supplier who prepared his bid with help from his brothers and expected to win. First line of the rejection email. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
After reviewing all bids, we've decided to go with another supplier this season.

text: پس از بررسی تمام پیشنهادها، ما تصمیم گرفتیم در این فصل با تامین‌کننده دیگری همکاری کنیم.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: an American buyer leaving a trade-fair booth. Listener: an Afghan carpet exporter based in Dubai. The American means it as a warm goodbye, with no concrete plan. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
Great meeting you. We should do lunch next time I'm in Dubai!

text: خوشحال شدم که با شما دیدار کردم. دفعه بعد که در دبی بودم، حتماً ناهار بخوریم!

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a European importer ending a video call about a possible saffron order. Listener: the Afghan supplier on the call. The importer is lukewarm and has made no commitment. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
Sounds good. let's touch base soon and take it from there.

text: باشه، خوبه. به زودی با هم در تماس باشیم و از آنجا ادامه دهیم.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a foreign distributor declining an Afghan pine-nut exporter's partnership proposal without saying so. Listener: the exporter, who spent two weeks preparing samples and pricing. Closing line of an email. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
We'll keep your proposal on file and reach out if anything opens up.

text: پیشنهاد شما را در پرونده نگه می‌داریم و در صورت بروز فرصت، با شما تماس خواهیم گرفت.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a foreign wholesaler replying to an Afghan supplier who rebuilt and reshipped an entire damaged order at his own cost to keep the relationship. Listener: the supplier. This two-word reply is the entire message. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
Much appreciated!

text: بسیار ممنون

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a British buyer whose Afghan supplier apologized that the invoice was delayed by a banking problem. Listener: the supplier. The buyer means the payment schedule slips a few days, nothing more. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
Don't worry about the invoice for now. let's sort it out later this week.

text: حالا نگران فاکتور نشو. بیایید در این هفته آن را حل کنیم.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a foreign NGO logistics officer buying blankets in bulk. Listener: the Afghan wholesaler, who has offered a goodwill discount and will read a polite refusal as the opening move of taarof. The refusal is real and final. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
That's very generous, but we can't accept a discount on this one, our audit rules require we pay the listed price.

text: بسیار مهربانانه بود، اما نمی‌توانیم تخفیف را در این مورد بپذیریم؛ قوانین حسابرسی ما می‌طلبد که قیمت فهرست‌شده را پرداخت کنیم.

messages.content: Translate the following message to English: قابل نداره، از باغ خود ماست؛ ببرید خانه، نوش جان کنید.

text: It has no price – it’s from our own garden; take it home and enjoy.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a trader whose partner covered a customs fee for him without being asked. Listener: that partner, on the phone the next day. They have traded together for three years. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
دست شما درد نکند، ما نمک‌گیر شما شدیم.

text: Thank you, we’ve become your customs broker.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a pomegranate seller at a roadside stall. Listener: a passing customer who has picked out two kilos and asked the price. First interaction between them. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
قابل نداره، از باغ خود ماست؛ ببرید خانه، نوش جان کنید.

text: It’s not worth the price, but it’s from our own orchard—take it home and enjoy.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a freight forwarder asked by an Afghan exporter to find space on this week's fully booked cargo flight. Listener: the exporter, whose grapes will spoil if they miss the flight. The forwarder already knows the flight is full. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
I'll see what I can do.

text: من تمام تلاشم را می‌کنم.

messages.content: Translate the following message to Dari: Don't worry about the invoice for now. let's sort it out later this week.

text: حالا در مورد فاکتور نگران نشو. این هفته بعد آن را حل می‌کنیم.

messages.content: Translate the following message to English: چی پیسه خیر است جان برادر؟ موتر از خود ماست، اصلا قابل شما ره نداره!

text: What money is good, dear brother? The car is ours—there’s no way for you to get on it.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a foreign quality-control coordinator writing ahead of a factory audit. Listener: the factory owner, whose hospitality to guests is a point of honor and who will instinctively read the request as modesty to be overridden. Translate the message into Dari so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
A polite request before Thursday's visit: please, no gifts or lunch for the inspection team. it puts us in a difficult position with our head office.

text: قبل از بازدید روز پنج‌شنبه، خواهشمندیم که برای تیم بازرسی هدایایی یا ناهار ندهید؛ زیرا این امر ما را در موقعیت دشواری با دفتر مرکزی قرار می‌دهد.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a carpet exporter whose money changer quietly covered a transfer shortfall so a shipment could clear. Listener: the money changer (sarraf), on the phone the next morning. They have worked together for years. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
دست تان درد نکنه؛ نمک‌گیر شما شدیم، ای خوبی تان فراموش ما نمیشه.

text: Thank you—may your hands never ache. We’ve become your salt shaker, and we’ll never forget your kindness.

messages.content: You are translating a real message. Context: Speaker: a mechanic who has just finished repairing a taxi's brakes. Listener: the taxi driver, a repeat customer, holding out the payment. The bill was agreed that morning. Translate the message into English so the intended meaning and tone land correctly for that reader. Output only the translation.
چی پیسه خیر است جان برادر؟ موتر از خود ماست، اصلا قابل شما ره نداره!

text: What’s the payment, dear brother? The car is ours—there’s no way it can be yours.
